visualContract.layoutPolicy: Actual Root sizes sm/default/lg map to native 24/32/40px circles; source badge sizes map to8/10/12px. The primitive owns image loading/error and fallback delay. Root remains overflow-visible for the badge; image/fallback inherit circle clipping. Group retains native 8px logical overlap and pinned 2px rings. Native size/type artwork does not create a public type prop. Count has a selected default 32px presentation because its actual API has no size prop; applications may explicitly adapt className for other group recipes. Badge uses the pinned physical right/bottom anchor even in RTL; ordinary adjacent text conveys any essential status. Independently authored portrait assets are fixtures, not extracted native image claims.
